entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Only Captain-linked access/HR, fleet, dispatch/custody/proof/support and Captain-affecting WLT finance functions are in scope.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Only Captain-caused tracking/order-state readback is in scope; client-owned flows stay out.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Only partner-fleet and store↔Captain custody/handoff are Captain dependencies.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Primary surface: Identity/Workforce readiness, fleet/dispatch/execution, tracking/PoD/support and WLT finance/top-up/COD/earnings/payout.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Explicitly assessed to prevent scope bleed.
entries.exclusionReason: Captain custody excludes app-field and Captain finance requirements do not make field-only product behavior part of this package; generic shared-code proximity is insufficient.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a Captain-proven shared contract/component change affects an actual app-field consumer; verify that shared impact only.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Captain role/surface/access administration only.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Generic analytics does not own a required Captain write/readback.
entries.exclusionReason: No current Captain Product Truth makes authorization or state depend on analytics.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a current Captain contract explicitly requires analytics as canonical state/readback.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Catalogs do not own Captain access, assignment, custody, support or financial truth.
entries.exclusionReason: No direct current Captain dependency is established.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a current Captain contract makes eligibility/execution depend on catalog state.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Captain writer/readback.
entries.exclusionReason: Captain operator actions live in dedicated HR/operations/support/finance paths.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if Product Truth makes dashboard a mandatory Captain readback.

entries.name: hr

entries.name: login

entries.name: marketing

entries.exclusionReason: No applicable Captain Product Truth requires marketing.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a current Captain rule is explicitly governed by a marketing capability.
